Performers
Jascha Heifetz (violin) Documented

The named performer and instrument are explicitly credited in the recording description.

[1] [3] [5] [6]
Work version
Unknown Unknown

The performing edition and any editorial alterations are not identified in the recording source.

[1]
Recorded
1952, as dated by the source Documented

The Archive description explicitly says “rec. 1952”. Commons’ 1 January 1952 is not accepted as an independently established day; no session ledger or precise date is supplied.

[1] [3]
Place
Unknown Unknown

The source description and sleeve scans do not identify a session location.

[1] [3] [6]
Label
RCA Red Seal Documented

The photographed sleeve identifies RCA Red Seal and 45 Extended Play; this is not a 78-rpm carrier.

[5]
Catalogue
ERA 9544 Documented

The catalogue number appears on both sleeve photographs. Its issue date is not independently established.

[3] [5] [6]
Matrix, take, sides
Two record sides joined for the digital track; matrix and take numbers unknown. Documented

The item description explicitly states that the two sides were put together. The scans show the sleeve, not readable disc labels or runouts; no matrix or take identification is invented.

[3]
Transfer
Unknown Unknown

No transfer or restoration engineer is identified. An uploader account is present but is not expanded into an engineering credit.

[3]
Transfer date
Unknown Unknown

The Archive item was uploaded in May 2020 and Commons in January 2021; neither is established as the transfer date.

[3] [1]
Processing
Both sides of a 45-rpm EP combined; WAV source converted to FLAC and MP3 access derivatives. Documented

The Archive file manifest traces the FLAC to the WAV and its SHA-1 matches the Commons source. The side-join location, equalisation, speed correction and noise processing are not documented.

[3] [4]
Composition rights
Underlying composition is public domain under ordinary life-plus-70 terms. Inferred, not documented

Bach died in 1750. This does not clear a separately protected modern performing edition.

[2]
Recording rights
Rule 1 — Commons PD-EU-audio recording tag; territorial European public-domain basis. Documented

The file-description Licensing section explicitly applies PD-EU-audio to this sound recording. US public-domain status and the carrier’s first publication year are not independently established. The generic structured-data CC0 claim is not treated as a rights-holder dedication, and the Archive Public Domain Mark is not treated as a licence.

[1]

Johann Sebastian Bach, Partita No. 2 in D minor, Chaconne; Jascha Heifetz, violin. RCA Red Seal ERA 9544, 45-rpm EP, two sides combined; Internet Archive transfer via Wikimedia Commons. Commons states PD-EU-audio (territorial); US status unestablished. Rights statement
